title: Terse developer: PRs needing review, then a comment

chat.label: prs
chat.goal: Ask which PRs need your review on tidepool-hq/api, tersely. Then tell it to leave an 'lgtm, ship it' comment on the pg bump PR. Then you're done.
chat.opener: which prs need my review on api

judge: The bot answers tersely with the PRs waiting on Arjun (e.g. Fatima's #217 requested his review) in a short list, no fluff or offers; when told, comments 'lgtm, ship it' on the pg bump PR and confirms in a few words. Matches his developer shorthand without being cold.
